title: Analista de Infraestrutura Pleno I (PDV)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades:

  • Atuar com sustentação dos sistemas de PDV (TOTVS e Casa Magalhães) com foco em suportar as operações de lojas físicas;
  • Atuar, identificar e solucionar problemas de conectividade em lojas, avaliando equipamentos e link;
  • Acionar parceiros de conectividade quando necessário para reestabelecer serviços
  • Atuar, identificar e solucionar problemas de hardware nos PDVs das lojas;
  • Responsável por tratar os incidentes, sendo de software ou infra, das lojas de forma rápida e eficiente, seguindo os padrões definidos pelos parceiros internos e externos;
  • Atuar de forma proativa em lojas que apresentem sintomas de problemas em sua jornada de vendas;
  • Interpretar gráficos de alertas, quando indicadores saem do limite aceitável;
  • Negociar, envolver e buscar a integração do trabalho junto ao time de atendimento N1, garantindo sinergia, apoio e formação;
  • Responsável em manter a base de conhecimento e de procedimentos técnicos atualizada;


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em trabalhar com metodologia (ITIL e Framework Scrum);
  • Conhecimento ferramentas de gestão de TI, JIRA, TFS e Service NOW;
  • Conhecimento básico em scripts em powershell.
  • Conhecimento avançado em comandos de administração de sistema operacional Microsoft através de PowerShell ou prompt de comando;
  • Conhecimento avançado para suporte remoto em celulares Android e computadores windows;
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de rede (TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP e afins);
  • Troubleshooting em ambientes Microsoft Windows 7, Windows 10 e Windows 11.


Modelo 100% remoto.

At International Digital Partners (IDP) , we connect top global talent with fast-growing, innovative companies. We are looking for a Technical Recruiter , highly experienced, self-driven, and multilingual, to join our international Talent Acquisition team.   • Manage the full recruitment life cycle for technical roles: intake, sourcing, interviewing, coordinating, and offer negotiation;

  • Experience hiring across LATAM, U.S., and Europe;
  • Knowledge of international hiring models (contracting, nearshoring, etc.);

What We Offer

  • Fully remote, international working environment
  • Supportive, multicultural team and collaborative culture
  • Access to innovative global projects with high impact
  • Continuous learning and growth opportunities

title: Creative Production Lead
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!

﻿

About Olly Olly

Ready to roll up your sleeves and help transform local marketing forever? At Olly Olly, we're blending technology and real-world expertise to empower small businesses across the U.S. like never before.


We believe small businesses are the backbone of our economy. That's why we're on a mission to provide them with tools, strategies, and insights that help them rank higher, generate high-quality leads, get calls and reviews, and grow sustainably without the hassle.


The Olly Olly platform complements our hands-on service perfectly: it's no-nonsense, easy-to-use software that helps local businesses streamline operations, drive leads, and maximize revenue with minimal effort so they can focus on what they do best.


Why We Need You

You have the eye. You can look at a website for five seconds and know whether it builds trust or destroys it. You see the logo that looks like a 2008 Fiverr special, the stock photo that screams "we didn't try," the typography that signals cheap. And it bothers you. Physically.


We're building a production team that creates websites, logos, and visual assets for 4,000+ local service businesses—contractors, plumbers, attorneys, HVAC companies. These businesses live or die by how professional they look online. Your job is to make sure everything we ship makes them look like the best option in their market.


As Creative Production Lead , you'll manage a team of designers who assemble websites from content, photos, and structured data. You're not just assigning tickets. You're inspecting work daily, catching the details that kill credibility, coaching your team to see what you see, and refusing to let "good enough" out the door.


You can also DO the work yourself. When a logo needs to be created or fixed, you're not waiting for someone else. When a layout isn't working, you can open the file and make it better. You lead by example because you're a designer first, manager second.


The Impact You'll Have

  • Quality is your obsession. You review completed work daily—not for completion, but for excellence. You catch the weak logo, the amateur photo crop, the layout that buries the CTA, the color palette that feels dated. Nothing ships unless it meets your standards.
  • You inspect, you coach, you elevate. You're providing specific feedback on real work: "This logo doesn't work because the type is fighting the icon." "This hero image undermines trust—the lighting looks fake." "This layout guides the eye away from what matters." You're building your team's taste through detailed critiques.
  • You stay fluid. What looked great two years ago looks tired today. You're constantly studying what's working across industries, updating standards, killing approaches that stopped converting. When you spot a pattern that works, you train the team on it immediately.
  • You execute when needed. Logo needs a refresh? You can do it. Layout falling apart? You fix it. You're not above the work—you're the best at it.
  • You run production, not a gallery. This is high-volume. Your team handles hundreds of sites and thousands of updates monthly. You understand that speed and quality aren't opposites—they require discipline, systems, and people who give a damn.


What We Really Need From You

Core Requirements

  • 5+ years in visual design with a portfolio that demonstrates genuine taste—not just competence, but an eye for what converts vs. what just exists
  • 2+ years leading or managing a design team—you've held people to standards, given hard feedback, and developed talent
  • Hands-on execution skills: you can create and refine logos, fix layouts, improve visual hierarchy yourself
  • Production experience: you've worked in environments where volume mattered—agencies, e-commerce, high-output teams
  • Quality obsession: you reject work that's "fine" because fine doesn't win


What Would Be Big Pluses

  • Background in advertising, branding agencies, or e-commerce design
  • Experience with WordPress page builders (Elementor, WP Bakery, Divi, Gutenberg)—or willingness to learn fast
  • Understanding of conversion principles: what builds trust, what drives action
  • Experience building or maintaining design systems
  • Knowledge of SEO basics and how design choices impact performance


We'll teach you:

  • Our specific tools and workflows
  • WordPress/Elementor if you don't know them (you'll pick it up in a week)
  • Our brand guidelines and quality standards
  • The local service business landscape


What You'll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Salary: Competitive (based on experience and location)
  • Flexible work: 100% remote, core hours 8 AM – 5 PM EST for collaboration
  • Work-life balance: 15 vacation days + U.S. holidays
  • Growth path: This role leads to Director of Creative Production or VP of Creative. You'll build the team, the systems, and the culture.
  • Real impact: Your standards directly determine whether 17,000+ small businesses look like winners or also-rans.


Why Choose Us?

We're evolving from template-driven agency work to genuinely differentiated design. You'll build a team culture where craft matters, where mediocrity gets rejected, and where the work actually helps small businesses compete.


Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here—and your unique perspective helps us shape the future of small business growth.

description:

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About IDP

At International Digital Partners (IDP) , we connect top global talent with fast-growing, innovative companies. We are a fully remote, multicultural team focused on delivering real value to our clients through technology, consulting, and digital execution. Our mission is to build world-class technical teams, and that’s where you come in.


About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Recruiter , highly experienced, self-driven, and multilingual, to join our international Talent Acquisition team. This is a key role in helping us scale technical teams across the U.S., Latin America, and Europe. You'll own full-cycle recruitment for high-demand technical roles.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the full recruitment life cycle for technical roles: intake, sourcing, interviewing, coordinating, and offer negotiation;
  • Screen and assess candidates, both on soft skills and basic technical fit;
  • Source talent proactively via LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, and other sourcing platforms;
  • Maintain clear, professional communication in English and Spanish.
  • Build and nurture a pipeline of high-quality candidates across multiple regions and time zones;
  • Ensure a seamless, positive candidate experience from first contact to onboarding;
  • Contribute to process improvement and employer branding initiatives.


Requirements

Must-Haves:

  • 3+ years of experience in technical recruiting, with proven success in international or remote hiring;
  • Solid understanding of tech stacks, tools, and roles (e.g., Frontend, Backend, Full Stack, DevOps, Data, QA);
  • Fluency (B2) in English is a must; Fluency in Spanish is highly preferred but not required
  • Experience using ATS platforms (e.g., Manatal, Greenhouse, Bullhorn) and sourcing tools like LinkedIn Recruiter;
  • Ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, multicultural environment;
  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills, with a solution-oriented mindset.


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Background in tech consulting or staffing;
  • Experience hiring across LATAM, U.S., and Europe;
  • Knowledge of international hiring models (contracting, nearshoring, etc.);
  • Familiarity with Agile environments and distributed tech teams.


What We Offer

  • Fully remote, international working environment
  • Supportive, multicultural team and collaborative culture
  • Access to innovative global projects with high impact
  • Continuous learning and growth opportunities

title: Roteirista
description:
1 Vaga para Roteirista / Copywriter de Shorts


Canal com 7 milhões de inscritos.

Skorpion Gamer:


Estamos procurando um roteirista criativo e estratégico pra entrar na nossa equipe e elevar o nível dos vídeos.

Seu foco será roteiros de fala, copy de retenção e análise de dados, sempre pensando em segurar o público do primeiro ao último segundo.

Se você entende como transformar ideia em gancho forte, sabe analisar números e gosta de crescer junto com uma equipe unida, essa vaga pode ser sua.


O que você vai fazer:

• Criar roteiros de fala para Shorts, com foco em retenção;

• Desenvolver ganchos fortes nos primeiros segundos;

• Analisar analytics/dados dos vídeos (retenção, CTR, visualizações, quedas);

• Ajustar e otimizar roteiros com base no que performa melhor;

• Trabalhar em conjunto com editores e criador, refinando ideias diariamente;

• Propor melhorias criativas e estratégicas para o conteúdo no geral.


Requisitos mínimos:

• Experiência comprovada como roteirista, copywriter ou criador de conteúdo;

• Conhecimento prático em retenção de Shorts / TikTok / Reels;

• Saber interpretar dados e métricas de performance;

• Ser pessoa física e emitir nota fiscal.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas contam muito):

• Já ter trabalhado com canais de games, entretenimento ou conteúdo rápido;

• Saber escrever linguagem natural, dinâmica e envolvente (nada robótico);

• Ter noções de storytelling curto e cliffhangers;


Sobre a rotina:

• Roteiros organizados semanalmente;

• Comunicação direta com a equipe (sem intermediários);

• Ajustes constantes com base nos resultados dos vídeos;

• Comprometimento com prazos e qualidade é essencial.

description:

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking multiple remote, full-time Senior Software Engineers with 5+ years of software development experience and a strong background in Ruby on Rails or Golang, as well as SQL, to join our U.S. client's engineering organization. You will build and maintain clients' software product lines to ensure they deliver value efficiently and reliably for their customers.

No two days are the same; you'll never stop learning and growing. You'll have the autonomy to make important decisions about systems and processes while receiving support and guidance along the way.

You will enjoy working in a flexible remote environment where mutual respect is a key ingredient. The team is supportive, highly talented, and always encouraged to communicate ideas with the executive team. The client's Engineering team is critical to the company's continued success and would like to thank you for your feedback.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land software solutions. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Develop clean, efficient, and well-documented code using modern software development practices
  • Diagnose and resolve production issues impacting uptime, stability, or performance
  • Profile and optimize code, database queries, and API interactions to improve response times and scalability
  • Collaborate with Product and QA teams to enhance reliability and maintainability of core systems
  • Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and performance tuning initiatives
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts across the full SDLC from incident prevention to automated testing and deployment


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of strong experience as a software engineer in a SaaS or cloud-based environment
  • Strong computer science foundation in algorithms
  • Experience working on enterprise web application development
  • Experience with Ruby and or/Golang
  • Experience with relational databases, such as SQL Server
  • Experience with JavaScript libraries
  • Proficiency with developing SaaS-based applications for any central cloud platform
  • Proficiency with Agile methods, Git, or continuous integration
  • Highly adaptable, capable of learning new technologies
  • Knowledge of the HTTP protocol as well as web services written in SOAP, XML-RPC, REST, or equivalent technologies
  • Understanding of good unit and functional test writing
  • Familiarity with microservices, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience in energy industry software, particularly upstream or midstream workflows
  • Comfortable working within a fast-paced environment
  • Self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Java Software Engineer
description:

Location: Remote in Brazil

Type: Contract

  • Deploy monitor and support applications running on Kubernetes across cloud environments

title: Engenheiro de Proposta e Aplicação
description:
Descrição


Sobre a NARI Brasil

A NARI Brasil é uma empresa integrante ao NARI Group Corporation, líder no fornecimento de equipamentos para o setor de energia elétrica na China. Fundado em 1973, o grupo NARI dedica-se a oferecer tecnologias de ponta.

Desde sua fundação no Brasil em 2013 com suas operações em Sorocaba-SP, a NARI Brasil tem se destacado no desenvolvimento e comercialização de sistemas de controle e proteção de subestações, com foco em soluções inovadoras e de alta qualidade.


Oportunidade

Engenheiro de Proposta e Aplicação

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro de Proposta e Aplicação para compor nosso time Comercial em Sorocaba-SP. Se você possui experiência no setor de energia elétrica e está em busca de desafios, essa oportunidade pode ser interessante para você!


Requisitos

  • Graduação em Engenharia elétrica;
  • Experiência no setor elétrico;
  • Experiência com propostas (especificações técnicas, estimativa de custos e impostos);
  • Inglês (nível avançado);
  • MS Office, AutoCAD (diferencial);
  • Carteira de motorista (tipo B).


Descrição das Atividades

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced a DevOps Engineer to support the transition of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) backend system from a Proof of Concept (PoC) to a scalable, production-ready platform.

This role will focus on building, configuring, and deploying a serverless architecture leveraging AWS Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS PostgreSQL, and other managed services.

You will collaborate closely with RedTeam’s existing .NET backend team to integrate a new Backend RAG API Service , enabling semantic search on construction specification documents through existing frontend applications.


Responsibilities

Infrastructure Provisioning

  • Execute curated deployment scripts using the AWS SDK.
  • Provision the full serverless architecture: API Gateway, Lambda, RDS (PostgreSQL), VPC components, and Bedrock Knowledge Base .

API Gateway Configuration

  • Deploy and configure RESTful API endpoints for chat query orchestration.
  • Ensure correct integration with the customer’s .NET API, where authentication/authorization is handled (no native AWS auth).

AWS Lambda Deployment

  • Deploy the API Orchestrator Lambda and the Ingestion & KB Sync Lambda functions.
  • Ensure Lambdas run inside the VPC and can be invoked by the customer’s .NET backend.

Networking & Security

  • Configure VPC networking, subnets, and access control for RDS connections.
  • Implement pragmatic least-privilege IAM policies for all components.

S3 Integration Setup

  • Configure Amazon S3 as the corpus data source for the AWS Bedrock Knowledge Base.
  • Enable automatic synchronization between the S3 bucket and the Knowledge Base.

Database Deployment

  • Deploy and configure the Amazon RDS PostgreSQL instance for chat history and conversation memory.
  • Execute necessary DDL changes and schema configuration.

Observability Setup

  • Configure CloudWatch logs and alarms for monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational health.


Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS Serverless Architecture (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB or RDS).
  • Experience provisioning AWS environments using AWS SDK, IaC scripts, or automated deployment pipelines .
  • Proficiency with VPC networking, IAM security policies , and integrating private Lambdas with RDS.
  • Knowledge of RDS (PostgreSQL) administration and schema deployment.
  • Experience with CloudWatch for logging, metrics, and alarm configuration.
  • Ability to integrate backend services with external APIs, especially .NET-based systems.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
  • Familiarity with AWS Bedrock , Bedrock Knowledge Base, and generative AI workloads.
  • Working knowledge of semantic search , embeddings, or vector-based search systems.
  • Experience with .NET backend integration or hybrid cloud/backend environments.
  • Exposure to infra-as-code tools (CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform).
  • Background in serverless best practices , scalability, and production hardening.



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who knows how to find, assess, and onboard world-class creative and production talent. You’ll help build the global network that powers SoCreative — sourcing videographers, photographers, designers, editors, motion specialists, creative leads, project managers, and other key roles across time zones.


This role is perfect for someone who’s organised, proactive, detail-oriented, and genuinely enjoys connecting great people with great opportunities. If you’re comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and love building strong talent pipelines, you’ll thrive here.

  • Source and attract top creative, production, and operations talent across global markets
  • Manage the full recruitment cycle — from job posting to screening, interviews, assessments, and onboarding

  • Highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across multiple roles at once

We help brands like American Express, Johnson & Johnson, Google, Schneider Electric and Toyota scale video and design content with speed, consistency, and creativity. Requisitos:

  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento de APIs e integrações em Python (FastAPI/Flask) e Node.js (Express/NestJS).
  • Experiência com versionamento (Git) e CI/CD (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Azure DevOps).
  • Prática com testes automatizados e documentação de APIs (OpenAPI/Swagger).
  • Atuação em Scrum ou Kanban , com participação ativa em dailies, planning, review e retro .
  • Colaboração em code reviews , pair programming e definição de padrões (linters, convenções, documentação).
  • Superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação / Segurança da Informação e afins;



Diferenciais:

  • Integrações com ferramentas de segurança (ex.: Identity & Access, PAM, Firewalls, EDR, WAF/CDN, CASB, etc).

  • Conhecimento de GraphQL , gRPC , serverless (Lambda/Cloud Functions).
  • Prática com observabilidade (Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/Opensearch, OpenTelemetry).
  • Noções de segurança de software (OWASP Top 10, secure coding).


O que oferecemos a você?


Na Cipher nosso beneficio é flexível VR/VA - Flash


Auxilio Home Office, para dar uma força adicional aos gastos do mês, já que estará trabalhando de casa na maior parte do tempo.

title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)
description:
For Brazil Only, PJ contract, Fluent English


Job Title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)


Type: Full-Time


About Indigo Beam

Indigo Beam is a digital transformation consulting firm dedicated to helping organizations evolve their business through modern technology solutions. We partner with our clients to improve customer experience, reengineer operational workflows, modernize legacy systems, and unlock data-driven insights that power smarter decision-making. Our services span Content Management, ERP, Digital Modernization, GIS & BI, CRM, and AI—helping businesses not just react to change, but lead it.


Key Responsibilities:

Leadership & Team Management:

  • Lead and manage cross-functional teams, including Technical Architects, Developers, QA, and Business Analysts, ensuring high performance and alignment with project goals.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Oversee the team's daily operations, ensuring tasks are completed on time and within scope.


Project Management:

  • Develop, maintain, and execute detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, with a focus on application/software development.
  • Own and facilitate project status meetings, adjusting project targets and schedules as needed.


Microsoft DevOps Project Management:

  • Manage and configure sprints, backlogs, and work items within Microsoft DevOps to ensure project transparency and alignment with Agile methodologies.
  • Track and manage user stories and epics, ensuring they are well-defined, prioritized, and aligned with project goals.
  • Facilitate daily stand-ups (scrums), sprint planning, and sprint retrospectives to ensure team collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Monitor and manage burndown charts and other Agile metrics to track project progress and ensure timely delivery.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure DevOps practices support efficient project execution and align with client needs.


Business Analysis:

  • Perform business analysis tasks on projects as needed, including requirements gathering, process mapping, and stakeholder interviews.
  • Ensure business requirements are clearly defined, documented, and communicated to technical teams.


Client Engagement:

  • Serve as clients' primary point of contact, ensuring their needs and expectations are met.
  • Communicate project progress, risks, and issues effectively to clients and stakeholders.
  • Ensure client satisfaction by delivering projects that meet or exceed their requirements.


Technical Oversight:

  • Collaborate with Technical Architects to ensure project designs align with business objectives and technical standards.
  • Review and approve technical and business documentation, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies to provide strategic technical direction.


Quality Assurance & Risk Management:

  • Implement quality control processes to ensure deliverables meet the required standards.
  • Identify and mitigate project risks, ensuring proactive solutions to potential challenges.


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Fluent English
  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a closely related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of IT Project Management experience in an Agile (Scrum) environment, with a strong focus on application/software development.
  • Prior hands-on development or coding experience.
  • Proven track record of managing teams of Technical Architects, Developers, QA professionals, and Business Analysts.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft DevOps, particularly in managing user stories, epics, sprints, and Agile metrics such as burndown charts.
  • Ability to perform business analysis on projects, including requirements gathering and process documentation.
  • Experience managing project budgets of over $1M and delivering projects on time and within scope.
  • Hands-on experience overseeing all phases of the SDLC, from requirements gathering to deployment.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills, with a proven ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organization skills and mindset.


Desired Skills & Qualifications:

  • Experience in the Oil and Gas industry is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience in a consulting role or possessing a consultative mindset.
  • PMP certification and CSM.


Other:

  • The role offers a dynamic work environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies and solutions.
  • The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.


Informations:

  • Type of Contract: PJ
  • Hours: Full-time
  • Location: 100% Remote
  • Start Date: Immediate
  • Duration: Long-term

title: Site Reliability Engineering
description:
Quem somos?


Somos parceiros estratégicos de nossos clientes na jornada de transformação digital, oferecendo soluções inovadoras para a implementação de tecnologias em nuvem. Com o apoio do nosso time de especialistas, auxiliamos na migração para ambientes em nuvem, modernização de aplicações, segurança de dados, serviços gerenciados e práticas de FinOps eficientes.


Se você tem paixão por tecnologia, busca inovação e acredita no poder da colaboração, temos a oportunidade ideal para você como SRE do nosso time de Suporte e Sustentação!


O seu papel será:

  • Construir e evoluir ambientes em nuvem utilizando infraestrutura como código, garantindo que os projetos sigam padrões de arquitetura, governança, segurança e boas práticas.
  • Atuar na operação e sustentação de ambientes críticos, realizando análises profundas de disponibilidade, capacidade, performance e escalabilidade.
  • Implementar e manter métricas, dashboards e alertas de observabilidade
  • Atuar no atendimento de incidentes complexos, realizando diagnóstico avançado e implementando soluções definitivas.
  • Apoiar o time de pré-vendas na validação técnica de arquiteturas, esclarecimento de dúvidas e recomendações de melhorias.
  • Acompanhar clientes em reuniões recorrentes, apresentar relatórios técnicos e orientar decisões estratégicas relacionadas ao ambiente.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de FinOps, analisando custos e propondo otimizações para aumentar eficiência e reduzir desperdícios.
  • Construir e aprimorar pipelines de automação e CI/CD, reduzindo intervenções manuais e aumentando a confiabilidade das entregas.
  • Aplicar práticas de segurança em nuvem, utilizando ferramentas homologadas, monitorando vulnerabilidades e propondo ações de mitigação.
  • Validar e homologar ferramentas técnicas utilizadas pela área, garantindo aderência às melhores práticas.
  • Compartilhar conhecimento com o time, apoiar analistas menos experientes e contribuir para melhoria contínua dos processos internos.


Para participar desse processo seletivo, você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência prática como SRE, DevOps ou Especialista Cloud, atuando em ambientes críticos e de alta complexidade.
  • Vivência com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) em nível avançado.
  • Domínio de infraestrutura como código, especialmente Terraform.
  • Experiência com observabilidade, análise de métricas, logs e alertas.
  • Conhecimento em automação, pipelines de CI/CD e integração contínua.
  • Vivência com containers, microserviços, redes e administração de sistemas Linux.
  • Experiência em análise de performance, escalabilidade e estabilidade de sistemas distribuídos.
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar e resolver incidentes complexos com autonomia e clareza.
  • Comunicação clara para expressar ideias técnicas de forma objetiva e alinhada ao cliente.
  • Pensamento analítico para avaliar cenários com profundidade e tomar decisões baseadas em dados.
  • Proatividade para atuar preventivamente, antecipando problemas e propondo soluções.
  • Trabalho em equipe para colaborar com diferentes áreas e sustentar um ambiente de confiança e parceria.
  • Gestão do tempo para organizar prioridades e garantir entregas consistentes.

title: Java Specialist
description:
QAT Global , a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years in the industry, is seeking a highly skilled Java Specialist to join our global engineering team. We deliver world-class technology solutions to clients across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil, fostering a culture of engineering excellence and collaboration.


This is a full-time, 100% remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to work directly with our US-based customer while collaborating with cross-functional, distributed teams.

Advanced English proficiency is mandatory, as you will communicate daily with US stakeholders.


About the Role


We are looking for an expert-level Java/Spring Boot Specialist who can contribute to technical decisions, uphold engineering standards, and collaborate across backend and frontend components.

You will work with Solution Architects, BAs, DevOps, and full-stack developers across complex financial and operational domains, including Billing, Ledger, Invoice, and Remittance.


Although the focus of this role is deep Java expertise , experience with AI-assisted development (e.g., GPT, Claude) is a strong plus for candidates who already use or are interested in learning AI tools to enhance productivity.


Required Qualifications


  • Expert-level experience in Java and Spring Boot (core requirement).
  • Strong experience with Node.js , React , and PostgreSQL .
  • Experience with security , DevOps , Cloud , and the GitHub ecosystem .
  • Familiarity with GitHub Advanced Security, GitHub CI/CD pipelines, and versioning best practices.
  • Solid experience with AWS IAM and hands-on work with EC2, RDS, SQS .
  • Ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams and contribute to architectural decisions.
  • Experience working with complex business domains or enterprise-level systems.
  • Advanced English proficiency is mandatory


Nice to Have


  • Experience (or interest in learning) AI-assisted development workflows using LLMs like GPT or Claude for:
  • Code generation
  • Code review
  • Code refactoring
  • Prompt-based engineering patterns
  • Experience leading or mentoring distributed teams.
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.
  • Familiarity with modern architectural patterns and high-scale systems.

title: Engenheiro de software sênior
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!



O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Desenvolver e manter microsserviços em Java/Spring Boot
  • Construir e integrar APIs REST de alta performance
  • Implementar soluções em ambiente de nuvem e orquestração

O que você precisa ter?

  • Inglês avançado
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência com Java
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência desenvolvendo APIs REST
  • Experiência utilizando Spring Boot
  • Experiência desenvolvendo aplicações hospedadas em nuvem como GCP, mas experiência com AWS ou Azure também é aceita
  • Experiência com Kubernetes


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!


Benefícios para você:

  • Plano de saúde.
  • Vale Alimentação.
  • Vale Refeição.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Plano odontológico.
  • Gympass.
  • Meu Pet Club.

Além disso, oferecemos :

  • Incentivo a estudo após 1 ano de Dexian.
  • Programa de desenvolvimento e treinamentos.
  • Formação através de Trilha de Liderança.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
READ ME: To be considered for this role, please read the full post. Due to demand, we only review candidates who email with the requested details at the bottom. LinkedIn “Easy Apply” submissions will not be reviewed.


About Skip

Skip helps millions of entrepreneurs and small business owners access funding, grow faster, and build real businesses — all in one place. Our revenue is comparable to a high-growth Series B company and has doubled in the past two months. Over 1 million business owners trust Skip to simplify what used to be a maze of red tape.


Now we’re building the next evolution of entrepreneurship: an AI Cofounder that helps anyone start, run, and scale a business.


If you want to work on a product that touches real people — and directly helps them build their livelihoods — Skip is one of the most impactful places you can be.


The Role

This is a high-ownership, high-velocity engineering role.


As a senior full-stack engineer on our product and AI team, you’ll build new tools and experiences that give entrepreneurs real leverage — from conversational business planning to smart funding recommendations, automated documents, and personalized dashboards.


You’ll work directly with the founder and a tight product/design team. No bureaucracy. No layers. Just building, shipping fast, and seeing your work used by hundreds of thousands of people.


What You'll Do:

  • Build and ship new features using modern web technologies and AI APIs.
  • Integrate AI into user-facing flows — conversational builders, assistants, recommendations.
  • Contribute across Skip’s product stack: React/Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Postgres, Supabase.
  • Rapidly prototype, test with real users, and iterate based on data and feedback.
  • Work closely with product, design, and support to uncover what actually moves the needle.
  • Help shape the architecture and UX of Skip’s AI Cofounder product.
  • (Optional/Secondary) Explore RAG, embeddings, or personalization systems — only if interested.


About You:

  • 5+ years of engineering experience , with strong experience shipping production features.
  • Strong with TypeScript and React/Next.js .
  • Comfortable across the stack or eager to work full-stack.
  • Curious about AI and excited to integrate AI capabilities into real products.
  • Communicative, proactive, and collaborative — you’re comfortable working closely with product and design.
  • You care about impact: you want your work to help real entrepreneurs build real businesses.


Why Join Skip?

  • You’ll be one of the core engineers shaping Skip’s AI Cofounder — a generational product shift.
  • You’ll work with an inspiring, high-output engineering/design team (including a strong Brazil engineering team).
  • You’ll have real ownership — not a feature factory, not endless specs.
  • You’ll see the impact of your work directly: from solo founders to growing teams across the U.S.
  • You’ll ship fast and learn fast.


Compensation:

  • Base Salary: $60,000–$80,000 USD equivalent (paid in USD or BRL)
  • Equity: 0.10%–0.40% — meaningful ownership in a fast-growing company
  • Paid time off + remote-first + autonomy to do your best work


How to Apply


Email:

Subject: Senior Software Engineer Position


Before emailing take a look through Skip including and share in 2-3 sentences why Skip's mission resonates with you and what's most important to you in your next role. You'll get a reply with next steps. We review all applications manually — no LinkedIn black hole.


We're building the future of entrepreneurship. Join us.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who knows how to find, assess, and onboard world-class creative and production talent. You’ll help build the global network that powers SoCreative — sourcing videographers, photographers, designers, editors, motion specialists, creative leads, project managers, and other key roles across time zones.


This role is perfect for someone who’s organised, proactive, detail-oriented, and genuinely enjoys connecting great people with great opportunities. If you’re comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and love building strong talent pipelines, you’ll thrive here.


What you’ll do

  • Source and attract top creative, production, and operations talent across global markets
  • Manage the full recruitment cycle — from job posting to screening, interviews, assessments, and onboarding
  • Build strong talent pools for high-demand roles (design, video, motion, PM, creative leads)
  • Work closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements and refine talent profiles
  • Conduct structured interviews and evaluate candidates for skills, experience, and culture fit
  • Maintain organised, up-to-date applicant pipelines and recruitment dashboards
  • Implement scalable sourcing strategies using LinkedIn, job boards, communities, referrals, and outreach tools
  • Maintain clear, timely communication with candidates to ensure a positive experience
  • Help improve hiring processes, documentation, and workflows as we grow


What you’ll bring

  • 2+ years experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, or sourcing (creative, agency, or tech experience preferred)
  • Strong sourcing skills and familiarity with modern recruitment tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, AI sourcing tools, etc.)
  • Ability to assess creative and operational talent across multiple specialties
  • Clear and confident communication in English, able to manage candidate expectations and present opportunities effectively
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across multiple roles at once
  • A positive, collaborative mindset and willingness to take ownership
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-moving, remote-first environment


Why join SoCreative?

We help brands like American Express, Johnson & Johnson, Google, Schneider Electric and Toyota scale video and design content with speed, consistency, and creativity. We’re a creative company built for quality and flexibility — powered by smart tech, streamlined systems, and a global network of top-tier talent.


You’ll join a supportive, fast-moving team that values clear communication, creative thinking, and getting things done. If you’re eager to grow, take initiative, and help shape a modern creative operation — we’d love to hear from you!

title: Client Services Representative
description:
Mobility Care Associate


Job Type: Full-time, Overnight Freelancer Position

Location: Remote - Brazil - Work from home

Hours: Set Schedule Monday – Friday, 3pm - 12am CST


**** This schedule is set and will not change ****


**** Resumes must be submitted in English ****


On behalf of our client, we are seeking a detail-oriented and process-driven professional with excellent communication skills to join the Mindglobal team as a Mobility Care Associate .

Mindglobal , listed in Gartner's 2021 Market Guide, offers corporate TEM (Telecom Expense Management) solutions for Fortune 500 enterprises around the world. They are adding new members to their Brazilian team.


Position Overview

As a Mobility Care Associate for Mindglobal , you are responsible for providing customer and technical assistance and support related to mobile device systems, hardware, software, company and carrier processes, and client procedures. You will respond to queries by inbound phone call, email and as assigned, respond in a timely and professional manner, isolate issues and requests, and determine and implement a resolution as per client specific company procedures.


This position is responsible for general customer service and completion of our clients’ day-to-day tasks within measurable SLA metrics.


What you'll do:

  • Quickly and professionally answer inbound client calls according to each client’s preferred greeting and nomenclature
  • Respond to requests for assistance sent by email and received by our Helpdesk Ticketing solution professionally and using appropriate templates, verbiage and guidelines, and within each client’s desired response SLA
  • Understand, access, and efficiently use carrier portals and other tools
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues involving clients’ supported hardware, Mindglobal tools and carrier systems
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues involving clients’ supported MDM and related systems, Mindglobal published client- and inside-facing tools, and carrier portals
  • Research process, policy and procedure questions using available informational resources
  • Using appropriate and professional grammar and communication skills, advise client employees on appropriate action(s), timelines, outcomes, etc.
  • Follow Mindglobal’s standard help desk procedures according to each client’s agreements, preferences and processes as noted in the KB, and as may be advised by MCM/CM and Helpdesk management
  • Ensure 100% of your client-related work is entered, tracked and documented in our Helpdesk Ticketing system correctly
  • Provide guidance to clients’ employees on proper use of Mindglobal specific websites and tools
  • Understand and explain client-specific processes and procedures as well as carrier specific data to clients’ employees
  • Refer and redirect non-Helpdesk requests to appropriate resource(s)
  • Identify and escalate situations requiring urgent attention and to the most appropriate resource
  • Stay current with industry trends, mobile technologies, internal systems and information, changes and updates
  • Proper and appropriate use of PC/Laptop and related equipment for Mindglobal’s purposes
  • Proper and appropriate use of Mindglobal’s electronic tools and resources for Mindglobal’s purposes


Who you are:

  • Proficient and professional/native level English speaker and writer
  • Able to multi-task and juggle a large volume of tasks
  • Consistently reliable: able to be on time and present when scheduled
  • Professional behavior in the workplace, remotely, and anywhere your Mindglobal affiliation is known
  • Excellent communication skills – verbal and written
  • Self-motivated to be effective with minimal supervision
  • Detail, process and results oriented
  • Ability to avoid distraction and consistently work throughout a scheduled shift
  • Previous experience in mobile/wireless industry a plus


What Mindglobal offers:

  • Career Growth – Mindglobal prioritizes internal promotions.
  • Remote Flexibility – Work from home in Brazil.
  • Company Culture – A collaborative and supportive team environment.


Job Type: Full-time, Contract position

This is a freelancer position. Benefits (such as healthcare, paid time off or 13th month pay) are not provided. You will be an independent direct contractor ("freelancer") with Mindglobal and paid hourly for time worked. You will be scheduled to work 40 hours per week and as a contractor can choose your time off and holidays.


Compensation & Hours:

Pay: $6.60 USD per hour - This amount of hourly pay is only associated with this “overnight” shift as it includes an overnight pay differential.


Hours: Set schedule Monday – Friday, 3pm - 12am CST


Horário de trabalho:

  • Turno de 8 horas


Idioma:

  • English (Obrigatório)

  • Identify and escalate situations requiring urgent attention and to the most appropriate resource
  • Stay current with industry trends, mobile technologies, internal systems and information, changes and updates
  • Proper and appropriate use of PC/Laptop and related equipment for Mindglobal’s purposes
  • Proper and appropriate use of Mindglobal’s electronic tools and resources for Mindglobal’s purposes


Who you are:

What Mindglobal offers:

title: Desenvolvedor de Integrações (APIs)
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos a Cipher, uma empresa do grupo Prosegur especializada em Cibersegurança. A Prosegur é líder global no setor em serviços integrados de segurança (vigilância e tecnologia corporativa), monitoramento de alarmes, transporte de valores. Com uma presença internacional em 25 países a Prosegur, proporciona às empresas e lares, uma segurança de confiança baseada nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado.

Valorizamos e incentivamos o conhecimento técnico e a capacidade de inovar de Nossa Gente e acreditamos que assim é possível atingir nosso propósito de tornar o mundo mais seguro para todos.

Se você se identifica com o nosso negócio e propósito, venha fazer parte do nosso time e acelerar sua carreira.


Quais são os desafios?

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter integrações de APIs em Python e Node.js (REST/GraphQL, webhooks, SDKs).
  • Construir conectores para ferramentas de segurança (ex.: autenticação/identidade, gerenciamento de acessos, WAF, SIEM, EDR) e sistemas corporativos (ERP, CRM, ITSM).
  • Implementar automatizações de processos (jobs, schedulers, filas).
  • Garantir observabilidade (logs estruturados, métricas, tracing) e qualidade (testes unitários/integrados, cobertura).
  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança em integrações (auth, tokens, secrets, criptografia em trânsito/repouso).
  • Trabalhar em squads ágeis : participar de plano de sprint , daily , reviews e retros ; colaborar na refinação de histórias e estimativas.
  • Participar de code reviews , documentar integrações (README, OpenAPI/Swagger).


Requisitos:

  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento de APIs e integrações em Python (FastAPI/Flask) e Node.js (Express/NestJS).
  • Experiência com versionamento (Git) e CI/CD (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Azure DevOps).
  • Prática com testes automatizados e documentação de APIs (OpenAPI/Swagger).
  • Atuação em Scrum ou Kanban , com participação ativa em dailies, planning, review e retro .
  • Colaboração em code reviews , pair programming e definição de padrões (linters, convenções, documentação).
  • Superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação / Segurança da Informação e afins;



Diferenciais:

  • Integrações com ferramentas de segurança (ex.: Identity & Access, PAM, Firewalls, EDR, WAF/CDN, CASB, etc).
  • Experiência em cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), containers (Docker) e Infra-as-Code (Terraform).
  • Conhecimento de GraphQL , gRPC , serverless (Lambda/Cloud Functions).
  • Prática com observabilidade (Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/Opensearch, OpenTelemetry).
  • Noções de segurança de software (OWASP Top 10, secure coding).


O que oferecemos a você?


Na Cipher nosso beneficio é flexível VR/VA - Flash


Auxilio Home Office, para dar uma força adicional aos gastos do mês, já que estará trabalhando de casa na maior parte do tempo.

title: Java Specialist
description:
QAT Global , a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years in the industry, is seeking a highly skilled Java Specialist to join our global engineering team. We deliver world-class technology solutions to clients across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil, fostering a culture of engineering excellence and collaboration.


This is a full-time, 100% remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to work directly with our US-based customer while collaborating with cross-functional, distributed teams.

Advanced English proficiency is mandatory, as you will communicate daily with US stakeholders.


About the Role


We are looking for an expert-level Java/Spring Boot Specialist who can contribute to technical decisions, uphold engineering standards, and collaborate across backend and frontend components.

You will work with Solution Architects, BAs, DevOps, and full-stack developers across complex financial and operational domains, including Billing, Ledger, Invoice, and Remittance.


Although the focus of this role is deep Java expertise , experience with AI-assisted development (e.g., GPT, Claude) is a strong plus for candidates who already use or are interested in learning AI tools to enhance productivity.


Required Qualifications


  • Expert-level experience in Java and Spring Boot (core requirement).
  • Strong experience with Node.js , React , and PostgreSQL .
  • Experience with security , DevOps , Cloud , and the GitHub ecosystem .
  • Familiarity with GitHub Advanced Security, GitHub CI/CD pipelines, and versioning best practices.
  • Solid experience with AWS IAM and hands-on work with EC2, RDS, SQS .
  • Ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams and contribute to architectural decisions.
  • Experience working with complex business domains or enterprise-level systems.
  • Advanced English proficiency is mandatory


Nice to Have


  • Experience (or interest in learning) AI-assisted development workflows using LLMs like GPT or Claude for:
  • Code generation
  • Code review
  • Code refactoring
  • Prompt-based engineering patterns
  • Experience leading or mentoring distributed teams.
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.
  • Familiarity with modern architectural patterns and high-scale systems.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

title: Executive Assistant
description:

This is a high-trust, high-ownership role where you’ll act as an extension of the founder’s operational capacity, keeping things organized, moving, and aligned. title: Desenvolvedor de Backend .NET
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Líder global em soluções transacionais , conecta empresas, empregados e comerciantes há mais de 50 anos. Atua em três frentes: Benefícios e Engajamento , Mobilidade e Soluções de Pagamentos e Novos Mercados . Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) .NET Pleno para atuar na equipe de Infraestrutura. Buscamos alguém com experiência na função , que tenha vontade de aprender continuamente e trabalhar de forma colaborativa em equipe .

O projeto envolve o desenvolvimento de uma nova plataforma , composta por APIs, processadores e um portal , utilizando .NET 6 e ReactJS .

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Projetar, desenvolver e apoiar na implantação de sistemas e aplicações conforme as tecnologias e padrões definidos.
  • Desenvolver código limpo, organizado e bem testado, alinhado às boas práticas de arquitetura de software.
  • Atuar em um ambiente ágil, multidisciplinar e colaborativo.
  • Participar de todas as cerimônias do processo de desenvolvimento, desde o planejamento de releases até a entrega e implantação das soluções.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com Microserviços , C# , ASP.NET , .NET Architecture e Web Services ;
  • Banco de dados SQL Server ;
  • Conhecimentos em HTML , JavaScript , Docker e Kubernetes .


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência com DHTML , Web Design , XSLT , Visual Basic e Crystal Reports ;
  • Conhecimento ou experiência com UML , RUP e especificação de casos de uso ;
  • Vivência no setor financeiro será um diferencial.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Site Reliability Engineering
description:
Quem somos?


Somos parceiros estratégicos de nossos clientes na jornada de transformação digital, oferecendo soluções inovadoras para a implementação de tecnologias em nuvem. Com o apoio do nosso time de especialistas, auxiliamos na migração para ambientes em nuvem, modernização de aplicações, segurança de dados, serviços gerenciados e práticas de FinOps eficientes.


Se você tem paixão por tecnologia, busca inovação e acredita no poder da colaboração, temos a oportunidade ideal para você como SRE do nosso time de Suporte e Sustentação!


O seu papel será:

  • Construir e evoluir ambientes em nuvem utilizando infraestrutura como código, garantindo que os projetos sigam padrões de arquitetura, governança, segurança e boas práticas.
  • Atuar na operação e sustentação de ambientes críticos, realizando análises profundas de disponibilidade, capacidade, performance e escalabilidade.
  • Implementar e manter métricas, dashboards e alertas de observabilidade
  • Atuar no atendimento de incidentes complexos, realizando diagnóstico avançado e implementando soluções definitivas.
  • Apoiar o time de pré-vendas na validação técnica de arquiteturas, esclarecimento de dúvidas e recomendações de melhorias.
  • Acompanhar clientes em reuniões recorrentes, apresentar relatórios técnicos e orientar decisões estratégicas relacionadas ao ambiente.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de FinOps, analisando custos e propondo otimizações para aumentar eficiência e reduzir desperdícios.
  • Construir e aprimorar pipelines de automação e CI/CD, reduzindo intervenções manuais e aumentando a confiabilidade das entregas.
  • Aplicar práticas de segurança em nuvem, utilizando ferramentas homologadas, monitorando vulnerabilidades e propondo ações de mitigação.
  • Validar e homologar ferramentas técnicas utilizadas pela área, garantindo aderência às melhores práticas.
  • Compartilhar conhecimento com o time, apoiar analistas menos experientes e contribuir para melhoria contínua dos processos internos.


Para participar desse processo seletivo, você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência prática como SRE, DevOps ou Especialista Cloud, atuando em ambientes críticos e de alta complexidade.
  • Vivência com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) em nível avançado.
  • Domínio de infraestrutura como código, especialmente Terraform.
  • Experiência com observabilidade, análise de métricas, logs e alertas.
  • Conhecimento em automação, pipelines de CI/CD e integração contínua.
  • Vivência com containers, microserviços, redes e administração de sistemas Linux.
  • Experiência em análise de performance, escalabilidade e estabilidade de sistemas distribuídos.
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar e resolver incidentes complexos com autonomia e clareza.
  • Comunicação clara para expressar ideias técnicas de forma objetiva e alinhada ao cliente.
  • Pensamento analítico para avaliar cenários com profundidade e tomar decisões baseadas em dados.
  • Proatividade para atuar preventivamente, antecipando problemas e propondo soluções.
  • Trabalho em equipe para colaborar com diferentes áreas e sustentar um ambiente de confiança e parceria.
  • Gestão do tempo para organizar prioridades e garantir entregas consistentes.

title: Operations Analytics Manager
description:
Job Description:

You will deliver insights using quantitative data to support our operations business. You will work closely with inventory, logistics, retail, and customer services team within the ops org, and partner with tech and finance teams working with nearly all aspects of our growing business. You will collaborate with operations analysts to understand, measure, and optimize efficiency in our operations, provide clarity of business performance, identify growth opportunities, and drive alignment to focus on the most impactful areas for our company.


What You Get To Do Every Day:

Understand and quantify operational efficiency metrics.

Design, implement, and report on item data throughout our receiving, authentication, launch and outbound flow.

Provide key product health measurements and reporting to support the business on a daily basis

Communicate product insights to business partner teams and leadership.


Minimum Requirements:

English - Mandatory

5+ years years analytics experience

Expert in SQL

5+ years of experience with BI tools such as microstrategy, tableau, looker etc.

Expert in translating between practical problems and technical formulations and solutions

Proven ability to design and implement time-sensitive strategic projects involving methodology development, analysis, strategic recommendations, and presentation of the findings

Proven track record of thriving with ambiguity


Preferred Requirements:

eCommerce or logistics industry experience preferred

title: Senior Applied Scientist
description:
Senior Applied Scientist (Remote – Brazil)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Location: Remote (Brazil) – São Paulo

Duration: Open-Ended


Job Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Applied Scientist to lead the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning solutions. In this role, you will influence the technical direction of the team, collaborate closely with Product and Engineering partners, and drive innovation across data-driven initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who combines strong technical expertise with leadership capabilities and a passion for building high-impact solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end development and deployment of Machine Learning models to solve complex business problems.
  • Write and maintain clean, efficient, scalable code following industry best practices.
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to extract insights and support data-informed decision-making.
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies, including deep learning and modern frameworks, to build robust models.
  • Take ownership of key system components and influence the broader technical strategy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to design deployable, production-ready ML solutions.
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers, fostering team expertise and growth.
  • Contribute to organizational technical leadership through patent filings and publications in top-tier venues.


Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning.
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML and deep learning models in production at scale.
  • Deep understanding of ML best practices (A/B testing, pipelines, feature engineering, experiment design).
  • Strong knowledge of algorithms and techniques such as gradient boosting, deep neural networks, transformers, and optimization methods.
  • Experience in Computer Vision ; experience in Causal Inference is highly desirable.
  • Expertise with Python scientific libraries (NumPy, pandas, Polars) and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-Learn).
  • Strong data engineering skills and comfort working with large-scale datasets.
  • Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark).
  • Experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Fluency in Python and SQL .


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, OR, or related fields.
  • Experience applying ML to real-world retail industry problems.
  • Familiarity with modern MLOps tools and pipelines .
  • Impact-driven mindset and commitment to delivering high-quality models.
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities with experience guiding or managing technical teams.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer (Java + Node.js)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: Long Term

Type: Contract/PJ


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement and maintain distributed backend services using Java and Node.js.
  • Build and optimize message-driven architectures and data pipelines using Apache Kafka.
  • Develop scalable, resilient APIs and backend components.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following best engineering practices.
  • Deploy, monitor and operate applications in Kubernetes across AWS and/or GCP.
  • Collaborate with architects and product teams on system components and integrations.
  • Participate in code reviews, system design sessions, and operational readiness activities.
  • Troubleshoot production issues across services and infrastructure.
  • Prototype new technologies to improve performance, reduce cost, and increase engineering velocity.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering.
  • Strong expertise in Java (backend, microservices, distributed systems).
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, offsets, stream processing).
  • Proficiency in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience deploying services on Kubernetes.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
  • Practical experience with AWS and/or GCP.
  • Solid understanding of design patterns, system architecture, and microservices.
  • Experience with MongoDB and PostgreSQL (schema design, performance, migrations).
  • Strong debugging, communication, and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in distributed teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with VOD Streaming platforms.
  • Basic knowledge of React for frontend integrations.
  • Exposure to IaC tools: Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation, etc.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana).

title: Cloud Architect
description:
About the company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Cloud Architect to join our team.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement a secure, governed, and cost-transparent AWS Landing Zone, leveraging AWS Control Tower to establish a consistent, well-architected cloud foundation. This foundational work will support the client's future initiatives in data analytics, AI, and workload management.
  • Lead Discovery & Planning workshops.
  • Design the multi-account strategy and VPC network architecture.
  • Perform the entire Implementation (deploying Control Tower, core security services, and IaC artifacts).
  • Conduct knowledge transfer sessions.


Required Qualifications

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Highly skilled in AWS design, Control Tower, security best practices, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC)
  • In-Scope Deliverables:
  • Comprehensive Landing Zone Architecture and Implementation Plan.
  • Deployment of a production-grade AWS Landing Zone configured via Control Tower.
  • Implementation of core security services: CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, and AWS Config.
  • Deployment of automated compliance controls via selected Conformance Packs.
  • Integration of IAM Identity Center (SSO) using Office 365 IdP.
  • All Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) artifacts (Terraform/CloudFormation templates).



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services

title: SAP BTP CAP/RAP
description:
Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) SAP com sólida experiência em extensões na SAP BTP, utilizando CAP e RAP, para atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções cloud nativas integradas a ambientes SAP (ECC/S/4HANA).

Vaga hibrida qualquer cidade.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e desenvolver aplicações e extensões na SAP BTP utilizando CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Implementar APIs, serviços OData/REST, lógica de negócio e integrações com sistemas SAP on-premise e cloud.
  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de aplicações existentes, realizando correções, melhorias e otimizações de performance.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo na área de TI (Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou cursos correlatos).
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento SAP.
  • Experiência sólida com SAP BTP e desenvolvimento utilizando CAP (Node.js/Java) e RAP (ABAP RESTful).
  • Bom domínio de ABAP OO, modelos de dados SAP, CDS Views, OData e conceitos de clean core.
  • Vivência com Git e práticas de desenvolvimento moderno (code review, testes, pipelines básicos).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma, com boa comunicação em times distribuídos.

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Certificações SAP em BTP, CAP, RAP ou S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com SAP Fiori/UI5, integrações com APIs externas e eventos (Event Mesh, Kafka, etc.).


O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Oportunidades para trabalho fora do Brasil
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

title: Engenheiro de Dados
description:
VAGA ABERTA: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior – Remoto


Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 28 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Engenheiro(a) de Dados . Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro de Dados;
  • Sólido conhecimento em serviços da Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Composer etc.);
  • Forte domínio em modelagem de dados (dimensional e/ou Data Vault);
  • Experiência em arquitetura de pipelines estruturados, semiestruturados e streaming;
  • Proficiência em SQL avançado;
  • Experiência com Python para orquestração, transformação e automações;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de versionamento (Git/GitLab), CI/CD e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Entendimento de princípios de Data Governance, Data Quality e segurança de dados;
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara e atuação consultiva junto às áreas de negócio.


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Liderança técnica de projetos de dados complexos;
  • Capacidade de definir arquiteturas escaláveis e padrões corporativos;
  • Experiência em ambientes altamente regulados ou com grande volume transacional;
  • Atuação prévia com integrações avançadas entre sistemas corporativos (ERP, sistemas legados, APIs, streaming);
  • Vivência em otimização de custo em plataformas de nuvem (cost efficiency);
  • Tomada de decisão técnica e influência sobre stakeholders de tecnologia e produto;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento de Pipelines de Dados: Projetar, construir e manter pipelines robustos, seguros e escaláveis em GCP, atendendo demandas analíticas, operacionais e regulatórias;
  • Modelagem e Estruturação de Dados: Criar modelos dimensionais, operacionais e/ou Data Vault que suportem análises consistentes e de alta performance;
  • Integração de Fontes Diversificadas: Implementar integrações entre sistemas corporativos, APIs, arquivos, eventos e fluxos de streaming (Pub/Sub), garantindo confiabilidade e rastreabilidade;
  • Gestão de Qualidade e Governança: Aplicar regras de qualidade, catalogação, linage e governança de dados, assegurando conformidade e segurança das informações;
  • Otimização e Performance: Monitorar, depurar e otimizar pipelines e consultas, reduzindo custos e garantindo SLA de processamento;
  • Atuação Consultiva: Ser o ponto de referência entre tecnologia e áreas de negócio, traduzindo necessidades em soluções de dados eficientes, escaláveis e aderentes ao ambiente do cliente;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Identificar gargalos, automatizar processos e propor inovações que elevem a maturidade analítica da empresa.
